title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Solids — 2020
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Differentiate between a crystalline solid and an amorphous solid.
questions.solution:
**Crystalline solid:**
- Its particles (atoms, ions or molecules) are arranged in a **regular, orderly three-dimensional lattice** with a definite repeating pattern.
- Each crystal therefore has a **sharp, definite melting point** and a **fixed heat of fusion**.
- It has a **well-defined and fixed geometrical shape**, and definite cleavage directions, so it breaks along definite planes.
- Anisotropic: physical properties differ along different directions.
- Examples: quartz, diamond, common salt, ice, sugar.

**Amorphous solid:**
- Its particles are arranged **randomly and irregularly**, without any long-range order.
- It **softens gradually over a range of temperature** and has no sharp melting point.
- It has **no definite shape** and breaks along **irregular or curved** surfaces.
- Isotropic: physical properties are the same in all directions.
- Examples: glass, plastic, rubber, candle wax, gum, gelatin, pitch.
questions.knowledgeNote: Crystalline solids have ordered lattice, sharp melting point and fixed shape; amorphous solids are random and soften gradually.
